title: A "smart" robot
text: 1 Two weeks ago, Bobby's parents bought a robot from a shop.
Look at this robot! He's very smart!
2 The robot cooked a big dinner. Bobby, Tina and their parents liked the food very much.
3 The robot played Chinese chess with Bobby. He won every time.
